# the other CBs holding the player's currency (global list zz_ef_holders_list; the amount
# in the player's money on each holder, var:zz_ef_holds_pc), for the pie chart in the trade balance.
# biggest holder first -- the amounts are set first, then ordered_country fills the list.
zz_ef_holders_update = {
	effect = {
		clear_global_variable_list = zz_ef_holders_list
		save_scope_as = holders_root
		every_country = { limit = { has_variable = zz_ef_holds_pc } remove_variable = zz_ef_holds_pc }
		if = { limit = { var:zz_ef_cur ?= flag:dinar } every_country = { limit = { NOT = { this = scope:holders_root } NOT = { var:zz_ef_cur ?= flag:dinar } has_modifier = has_central_bank capital = { has_variable = stockpiling_dinar_state_1 var:stockpiling_dinar_state_1 > 0 } } set_variable = { name = zz_ef_holds_pc value = capital.var:stockpiling_dinar_state_1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:zz_ef_cur ?= flag:dinar_algerian_dinar } every_country = { limit = { NOT = { this = scope:holders_root } NOT = { var:zz_ef_cur ?= flag:dinar_algerian_dinar } has_modifier = has_central_bank capital = { has_variable = stockpiling_dinar_algerian_dinar_state_1 var:stockpiling_dinar_algerian_dinar_state_1 > 0 } } set_variable = { name = zz_ef_holds_pc value = capital.var:stockpiling_dinar_algerian_dinar_state_1 } } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:zz_ef_cur ?= flag:dinar_iraqi_dinar } every_country = { limit = { NOT = { this = scope:holders_root } NOT = { var:zz_ef_cur ?= flag:dinar_iraqi_dinar } has_modifier = has_central_bank capital = { has_variable = stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_state_1 var:stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_state_1 > 0 } } set_variable = { name = zz_ef_holds_pc value = capital.var:stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_state_1 } } }
